implementation_commit: The commit containing this evidence; verify with git rev-parse HEAD and its Actions run.

environment.database: mongomock; isolated source export without .env, DASD or research-data

checks.scope: Saved metrics/split inventory; raw DASD absent
Locked versions/hashes, model forward passes, FFmpeg/FFprobe, real OpenFace blank clip (30 rows), backend readiness and frontend HTTP 200. Normal shutdown tested.
Declared synthetic numeric fixture, real gaze-v1 checkpoint; not participant or webcam validation
All five recorded-example pages inspected; model values/statuses/UI-PDF parity also tested programmatically

checks.check: Physical camera/microphone and usable-face webcam stages
Clinical validation or new accuracy evaluation

earlier_failures: One isolated backend invocation used PYTHONPATH=. instead of backend:.; an existing config-export import failed. Correct invocation passed.

Precision regression initially expected rounded stored probabilities; updated assertion now checks the original full-precision captured model reference exactly. A new test import collided with backend/scripts and was corrected to explicit run_path.

Original-motion browser runs intermittently stalled on animation actionability/session restoration on this host; no assertion was removed. Supported reduced-motion runs passed twice (36.4s and final 21.2s). Physical-device/original-motion reliability is not newly validated.
Starting the launcher while E2E occupied its ports failed explicitly; final launcher now checks port availability and was verified after stopping conflicting task services.
Docker access was denied in a sandbox-only preflight; the authorized local execution preflight passed with real Docker/OpenFace access.

coverage_boundaries.real: Frozen models; permitted cached development examples; permitted image/direct audio inference; FFmpeg/FFprobe/OpenFace blank execution; actual API persistence/auth; browser generated-tone inference
coverage_boundaries.controlled: Media denial/interruption boundaries; synthetic numeric gaze and tone fixtures; same-tab expiry event with real server logout/relogin
coverage_boundaries.not_established: Usable-face live webcam inference, camera unplug behavior on real hardware, new-domain accuracy, population calibration, diagnosis, ASD speech or multimodal diagnostic fusion

artifact_review: Only intended source/docs and aggregate outputs; no changed checkpoint binaries, raw participant recordings/images, credentials or private manifests. Pinned model hashes unchanged.
ci: Local checks do not establish CI success; inspect the Actions run for the pushed commit.
